question: Which word is chosen as Oxford Hindi word of the year 2019?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Samvidhaan**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Samvidhaan** was chosen as the Oxford Hindi Word of the Year for 2019.
 
• The word 'Samvidhaan' means 'Constitution' in English.
 
• The selection of 'Samvidhaan' reflects the significance of the Constitution in the public discourse during the year 2019.
 
• Oxford University Press (OUP) said that the word was selected as it "generated a great deal of discussion" and was widely used in 2019.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Oxford Hindi Word of the Year is a word or expression that has attracted a great deal of interest over the last year.
 
• This word is chosen to reflect the ethos, mood, or preoccupations of that particular year.
 
• Previous words of the year include 'Aadhaar' in 2017 and 'Nari Shakti' in 2018.
